parent.science: WSP77 frozen NEGATIVE: 254/4608 correct confident, 72 wrong, 49/3053 truly uncharged correct, Stage-A retention121/214; conventional fully trained MLP 2026 confident correct/354 wrong. Focused and G29 Ubuntu+Windows PASS, inherited full still in progress. Do not retune WSP77.

hypothesis: Rather than fitting individual 6-bit state/action examples with local ReLU prototypes, discover an action-conditioned Boolean causal effect function from PAID physical consequences using degree<=2 multilinear GF(2) parity features, compile discovered coefficients into a fully executable ReLU numerical neural matrix (no symbolic inference at runtime), and use source-blind identifiability from charged evidence to choose exact neural confidence gates. Can this improve truly never-paid causal prediction, cold retention and process cost relative to fully converged same-evidence end-to-end MLP, readout-only ReLU and an independent same-prior symbolic control?

source.cohort: SELFTEST only; protected DEV and PRIMARY never used
source.families: Four shuffled triangular degree-2 conditional XOR/AND, four degree-2 mixed cross-bit flips, four independent degree-2 sparse conjunction and pairwise XOR, four preregistered degree-3 hidden interaction NEGATIVE worlds. Each of six hidden public-action roles flips its own hidden sensor role unconditionally, with other flips depending only on lower-role target bits but factors can include higher- or lower-role sensor states. Six public bits and six public action channels, shuffled by independent SHA salted seeds. The full 64 visible states must be evaluator-only reachable in all 16 worlds. Primary degree<=2 source family STRONGLY matches learner grammar; do not claim independent physical family transfer.
source.physical: TWO source-identical independently physically PAID no-reset 144-action trajectories per world: same initial zero state and identical separately charged 96 A actions, then 48 B real physical actions chosen by fixed WSP76 source-blind actual charged action-contrast policy or separately SHA seeded uniform random action policy. Both separately pay ALL 144 actions, total 16*2*144=4608 actual physical charges. No teleport, arbitrary-state source query or evaluator truth during learning.
source.heldout: After all models and observed policies frozen: 64 possible source states ×6 actions=384 evaluator-only physical labels/world, 4608 primary, 1536 degree3 negative, 32 two-action evaluator tasks/world, at least 2880 genuinely never-PAID primary contexts by arithmetic.

writer.representation: One PUBLIC fixed bank of (6 actions)×(1+6+15)=132 ReLU conjunctive monomial detectors of degree0,1,2: gate(a,S)=ReLU(action_onehot[a] + sum_{j in S} statebit_j - |S|), yielding 0/1 on valid six-bit sensor/action inputs. Grammar fixed before physics; NO oracle source families or shuffles inside learner.
writer.learning: For each paid (state,action,nextstate) derive six real action-effect bits state XOR nextstate. With that action's 22 Boolean degree<=2 monomial inputs, build exact GF(2) bit-packed row-echelon linear constraints for all six output effect bits simultaneously. Inconsistent effects on paid data flag grammar mismatch and SOURCE-BLIND ABSTENTION for that action; no after-result selection. Set unresolved monomial coefficient bits to zero deterministically and solve exact basis equations for a consistent coefficient matrix. Each accepted physical row updates its compressed GF2 sufficient-stat basis, not arbitrary simulator queries; physical charges counted.
writer.numeric_forward: Actually MATERIALIZE learned causal effect coefficients (0/1, action×monomial×target bit) as dense numeric middle weight matrix connecting the 132 real ReLU detector outputs to six per-bit integer effect counters. Compute counter parity with ReLU sawtooth identity parity(c)=c+sum_{k=1}^{22}2*(-1)^k*ReLU(c-k) and final nextbit=statebit+flipbit-2*ReLU(statebit+flipbit-1). ALL heldout predictions must compute from these numeric matrices/relu operations ONLY; no GF2 solver, symbolic hypothesis or ledger at inference.
writer.confidence: When an action's charged GF2 equations are consistent, a query's 22 monomial bitmask is IDENTIFIABLE only if it lies in the paid observed row span; if not, source-blind abstain. Before seeing ANY heldout physical truth, compile identifiability into a second fixed public state/action ReLU detector head for each of the 384 publicly enumerable input identities, learned confidence weights 0/1 only. This may encode up to 384 confidence indicators, report parameter cost and prohibit source/heldout labels. Numeric inference uses only these detectors and learned numeric coefficient weights.
writer.online_custody: Stage A after 96 separately paid actions yields a cold numeric neural matrix snapshot and compressed sufficient-stat echelon, Stage B adds 48 further physically paid consequences, recomputes numeric weights and identifiability from compressed basis. Training ledger cannot appear in cold inference snapshot. Independently verify StageA true correct confident predictions remain after B, including cold numeric restore SHA parity and tamper rejection.
writer.negative_control: Four degree3 adversarial physics sources violate degree2 grammar. Report source-blind paid-row inconsistency rates, confident wrong on genuinely never paid, and entire heldout. Do not silently widen grammar or suppress scientific failures after results.

controls: INDEPENDENT from numeric neural forward: standalone GF2 symbolic charged-source exact rowspace solver with SAME degree<=2 public monomial class and SAME paid evidence; require prediction parity on all public state/action inputs. A tie means no neural superiority over this strong same-prior control.
Same observed action/consequence ledger WSP77 12-input ReLU numerical feature-growth Stage A and 144-observation readout-only ridge refit; no extra paid actions.

Same observed source ledger conventional fully end-to-end trained 12->32 ReLU->6 sigmoid MLP, three seeded Adam restarts<=6000 updates each, >=95% paid-row training exact required for convergence, report both original confidence-gated/forced results and equal-coverage confidence-ranked forced predictions by public input identity WITHOUT physical labels.

Equal physical action budget separate source copy using uniform random Phase B policy + the EXACT same numeric causal effect compiler, report if active contrast actually improves physical evidence; do not claim matched information.
Degree-one ablation removes degree2 monomials but uses exactly SAME observed ledger, rowspace screening, numeric matrices and cold inference; should fail on interaction physics, strong negative.
Exact paid observation memory with no extrapolation, unprogrammed/erased numerical learned coefficient matrix, cold SHA snapshot tamper, source import/symbolic inference leak negative controls.

frozen.classification: SELFTEST_SIGNAL only if EVERY condition passes; else SELFTEST_NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE

limitations: This is a consciously SOURCE-ALIGNED degree<=2 Boolean causal prior with known six public binary sensors/actions, not an independent universal causal feature discovery mechanism. The standalone equivalent symbolic solver may tie all physical outputs, and such a tie must be disclosed explicitly.
The GF2 exact-rank identifiability head can abstain on many genuinely never observed queries; absolute confident-correct and coverage must be reported, not only conditional error rate.

The confidence head enumerates all 384 unlabeled PUBLIC input identities per world; it cannot inspect their hidden physical outcomes, and is an OFFLINE diagnostic not scalable open-world uncertainty representation. Count every coefficient and neuron.

Learning coefficients via exact GF2 algebra from paid labels counts as real experience-driven weight programming, but parity/monomial circuit is hand-specified architecture rather than gradient-free general neural feature discovery.

Equal number of physically paid active/random actions does not imply equal acquired information; strong same-data neural and symbolic controls mandatory. The full effect of rank/coverage and CPU count must be measured.
A new positive synthetic SELFTEST_SIGNAL is not independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS, open-world learning, AGI, language or official FORGE/Yggdrasil research-loop integration.
qualification: Commit prereg FIRST before WSP78 source physics/model/test outcomes. Freeze everything including zero-fill solver, source seeds, comparisons and thresholds.
Require source-pinned focused Ubuntu+Windows, generated-only 3-file G29 atlas, mandatory inherited full regression both platforms on final exact candidate SHA/tree before ENGINEERING_PASS.

Never retune sources/thresholds or inspect protected DEV/PRIMARY data. Mechanical test bugs may be fixed only with exact semantic preservation and requalification; preserve failed runs and science receipts.
